advice_sticky: Mobile device '{device}' is stuck on node '{node}' with weak signal ({rssi} dBm). Toggle Wi-Fi on the device to trigger 802.11k/v TrueMesh roaming towards '{suggested}'.
overview_excellent: The eero mesh network is operating with excellent stability and efficiency. All primary TrueMesh synchronization parameters, client signal quality, and WAN latency to your ISP are optimal.
overview_good: The eero network is fully functional, but exhibits localized inefficiencies preventing peak throughput. Minor signal attenuation or band balance factors were detected.
overview_critical: The network exhibits significant criticalities impacting user experience quality. Immediate action on reported nodes or links is recommended to restore full mesh coverage stability.
narrative_offline_nodes: **Disconnected Nodes:** Mesh node(s) ({names}) are offline or unreachable, reducing overall wireless coverage.
check_offline_nodes_desc: Check power adapter, electrical outlet, and upstream Ethernet cabling.
narrative_degraded_backhaul: **Degraded Backhaul:** Sub-optimal backhaul link detected on: {items}. If link negotiates at 100 Mbps, a legacy switch or faulty Cat5/Cat6 cable is throttling Gigabit throughput.
check_degraded_backhaul_title: Replace Ethernet cabling or reposition beacons
check_degraded_backhaul_desc: Verify that LAN cables are Cat 5e/Cat 6 with all 8 pins active and switch ports support 1 Gbps / 2.5 Gbps.
narrative_weak_clients: **Weak Client Signal:** {count} device(s) have RSSI below -75 dBm ({devices}), increasing retransmission rate and latency.
check_weak_clients_desc: Relocate critical clients closer or consider adding a mesh node to bridge dead zones.
narrative_band_24: **2.4 GHz Band Crowding:** Over 70% of wireless clients are operating on the 2.4 GHz band, which is prone to interference and offers lower spectral efficiency than 5 GHz and 6 GHz.
check_band_steering_desc: Allows eero TrueMesh to steer capable dual-band clients towards faster 5 GHz and 6 GHz frequencies.
narrative_sticky_clients: **Roaming Advisor (Sticky Clients):** Detected {count} mobile device(s) ({devices}) clinging to distant nodes with poor signal despite closer mesh nodes being available.
check_sticky_clients_desc: Toggle Wi-Fi on the flagged mobile devices to trigger 802.11k/v roaming to the closest node.
narrative_iot_anomaly: **Unusual Night IoT Traffic:** Abnormal data volume recorded during night hours (01:00 - 06:00) on: {devices}. Check device firmware or unintended cloud uploads/streaming.
check_iot_anomaly_desc: Verify cloud recording settings and firmware integrity of the involved smart devices.
check_optimal_desc: The eero fleet is performing at peak efficiency. All mesh links adhere to optimal performance standards.
narrative_none: No anomalies or penalty factors detected.
demo_anomaly_camera: Abnormal night upload of 1.42 GB between 02:00 and 05:30 (typical baseline is 15 MB).
demo_anomaly_relay: Unusual night traffic of 340 MB on smart relay switch (typical baseline 2.5 MB).
anomaly_night_traffic: Abnormal night traffic of {observed} MB detected (warning threshold: {threshold} MB) between 01:00 and 06:00 on '{device}'.
